name: Evil Doers
overview: Scripture reveals that the hearts of evil doers are continually filled with wickedness and corrupt desires, as seen in Genesis 6:5 where every thought is only evil continually. God hates the works of iniquity and abhors those who act deceitfully and violently, promising destruction for such workers of evil (Psalms 55:23; Proverbs 6:16; Proverbs 21:15). True entrance into God's kingdom requires doing the will of the Father rather than merely professing faith, highlighting the necessity of righteous living over empty words (Matthew 7:21; Matthew 12:36).
